node.title: Strange and Unusual
node.author: itsmeiggit
node.doctext:
Script that had been running fine stopped writing to a folder. Then it stopped retaining values to cross reference to not duplicate. Replaced it. Worked fine in another folder. Checked folder. Was chmod 777. What the?
Anybody anywhere ever get faced with this ridiculous set of events? Any trouble shooting potential tips? Thanks in advance.
